label: Soil moisture
title: Root-zone soil moisture compared with normal
subtitle: Oct 2026, against Oct in 11 earlier years
how: Each district shows the average moisture in the top metre of soil for the month shown, compared with the same month in every other year since 2015. "Very dry" means that month ranks in the driest 10% of those years, "dry" in the driest 30%, and the same in reverse for "wet" and "very wet". Use the Year and Month boxes to look at any month since April 2015.
limits: The values come from NASA's SMAP Level-4 product, which blends satellite observations into a land model. It is an estimate, not a direct measurement at depth.
The SMAP record starts in 2015, so "normal" rests on only 11 earlier years. Rankings are coarser than for rainfall.
The grid is about 9 km. It suits district averages, not individual farms, and small districts rest on one or two grid cells.
Under dense forest in the south the satellite signal is weak, so values there lean more on the model.
Each month is sampled on up to 6 days at one time of day, not averaged over every hour.
The estimates have not been checked against soil sensors in Ghana.

credits.text: Soil moisture: NASA SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP), NSIDC DAAC
